title: 同時看圖聽聲的兩種介入
timing_scope: experiment training, evaluation and local checkpoint saves; excludes image build, startup and HF uploads
peak_memory_scope: Main-process PyTorch CUDA allocator allocated-byte peak since its most recent reset. Branch measurements can reset this counter; this is not necessarily the full-experiment peak. It excludes subprocesses, reserved-but-unused allocator memory and CUDA driver memory. Use branch-specific memory measurements and their scopes for comparisons.

training.loss_probe: same deterministic batch before and after training
training.timing_scope: optimizer loop including logging, periodic local checkpoints and CUDA synchronization; excludes probes, evaluation and final file write

data.split_policy: held-out position and frequency; independently balanced shape and pitch

results.scope: two independent required attributes; individual masking/swapping tests actual modal use

hf.checkpoint_resume_scope: Backup includes the full experiment directory. Optimizer/RNG resume support depends on each checkpoint format and training entrypoint; a backup alone is not an exact-resume guarantee. Public inference exports remove optimizer/RNG state.
